changeSet.author: credesal
changeSet.comment: Preserve legacy payable account codes and accept an empty Office selection within the authenticated user's hierarchy.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE stretchy_report SET report_sql = $report$ WITH RECURSIVE selected_offices AS ( SELECT office.id, office.external_id FROM m_office office WHERE credesal_report_office_in_scope( office.id, '${officeId}', '${currentUserHierarchy}' ) ), legacy_account_names(account_code, account_name, parent_code) AS ( VALUES ('222099940101', 'RENDIMIENTO ACCIONES PREFERIDAS', '2220999401'), ('222099940102', 'DESEMBOLSO DE CREDITOS EN EFECTIVO SANTIAGO DE MARIA', '2220999401'), ('222099940103', 'DESEMBOLSOS DE CREDITOS EN EFECTIVO AGENCIA USULUTAN', '2220999401') ), account_nodes AS ( SELECT account.gl_code AS account_code, COALESCE(presentation.source_name, account.name) AS account_name, parent.gl_code AS parent_code, COALESCE( presentation.balance_nature, CASE WHEN account.classification_enum IN (1, 5) THEN 'D' ELSE 'A' END ) AS balance_nature FROM acc_gl_account account LEFT JOIN acc_gl_account parent ON parent.id = account.parent_id LEFT JOIN credesal_gl_account_presentation presentation ON presentation.gl_account_id = account.id
UNION ALL
SELECT legacy.account_code, legacy.account_name, legacy.parent_code, 'A' FROM legacy_account_names legacy WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM acc_gl_account account WHERE account.gl_code = legacy.account_code ) ), account_hierarchy AS ( SELECT account.account_code, 0 AS account_level, ARRAY[account.account_code]::VARCHAR[] AS account_path FROM account_nodes account WHERE account.parent_code IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT child.account_code, hierarchy.account_level + 1, hierarchy.account_path || child.account_code FROM account_hierarchy hierarchy JOIN account_nodes child ON child.parent_code = hierarchy.account_code WHERE NOT child.account_code = ANY(hierarchy.account_path) ), qualified_journal AS ( SELECT journal_entry.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(source_line.source_account_code, ''), native_account.gl_code) AS account_code, journal_entry.office_id, journal_entry.entry_date, journal_entry.transaction_id, journal_entry.ref_num, journal_entry.description, journal_entry.type_enum, journal_entry.amount, journal_entry.dimensions, COALESCE( presentation.balance_nature, CASE WHEN COALESCE(source_account.classification_enum, native_account.classification_enum) IN (1, 5) THEN 'D' ELSE 'A' END ) AS balance_nature FROM acc_gl_journal_entry journal_entry JOIN acc_gl_account native_account ON native_account.id = journal_entry.account_id LEFT JOIN credesal_arissto_gl_journal_line source_line ON source_line.target_journal_entry_id = journal_entry.id LEFT JOIN acc_gl_account source_account ON source_account.gl_code = source_line.source_account_code LEFT JOIN credesal_gl_account_presentation presentation ON presentation.gl_account_id = COALESCE(source_account.id, journal_entry.account_id) WHERE journal_entry.entry_date <= CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) AND journal_entry.currency_code = 'USD' AND journal_entry.office_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected_offices) AND ( jsonb_typeof(journal_entry.dimensions -> 'office') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM selected_offices office WHERE office.id = journal_entry.office_id AND office.external_id = journal_entry.dimensions ->> 'office' ) ) ), direct_account_values AS ( SELECT journal.account_code, MIN(journal.balance_nature) AS balance_nature, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN journal.entry_date < CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) THEN CASE WHEN journal.balance_nature = 'D' THEN CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END ELSE CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 1 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END END ELSE 0.00 END ), 0.00 ), 2 ) AS opening_balance, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM(journal.amount) FILTER ( WHERE journal.entry_date = CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) AND journal.type_enum = 2 ), 0.00 ), 2 ) AS debit_movement, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM(journal.amount) FILTER ( WHERE journal.entry_date = CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) AND journal.type_enum = 1 ), 0.00 ), 2 ) AS credit_movement, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN journal.balance_nature = 'D' THEN CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END ELSE CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 1 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END END ), 0.00 ), 2 ) AS ending_balance FROM qualified_journal journal GROUP BY journal.account_code ), visible_direct_values AS ( SELECT direct.* FROM direct_account_values direct WHERE direct.ending_balance <> 0.00 OR direct.debit_movement <> 0.00 OR direct.credit_movement <> 0.00 ), account_rollup AS ( SELECT direct.account_code AS source_account_code, direct.account_code AS report_account_code, direct.opening_balance, direct.debit_movement, direct.credit_movement, direct.ending_balance, ARRAY[direct.account_code]::VARCHAR[] AS account_path FROM visible_direct_values direct
UNION ALL
SELECT rollup.source_account_code, parent.account_code, rollup.opening_balance, rollup.debit_movement, rollup.credit_movement, rollup.ending_balance, rollup.account_path || parent.account_code FROM account_rollup rollup JOIN account_nodes child ON child.account_code = rollup.report_account_code JOIN account_nodes parent ON parent.account_code = child.parent_code WHERE NOT parent.account_code = ANY(rollup.account_path) ), rolled_account_values AS ( SELECT rollup.report_account_code AS account_code, ROUND(SUM(rollup.opening_balance), 2) AS opening_balance, ROUND(SUM(rollup.debit_movement), 2) AS debit_movement, ROUND(SUM(rollup.credit_movement), 2) AS credit_movement FROM account_rollup rollup GROUP BY rollup.report_account_code ), visible_accounts AS ( SELECT account.account_code, account.parent_code, hierarchy.account_level, account.account_name AS account_description, account.balance_nature, rolled.opening_balance, rolled.debit_movement, rolled.credit_movement, ROUND( rolled.opening_balance + CASE WHEN account.balance_nature = 'D' THEN rolled.debit_movement - rolled.credit_movement ELSE rolled.credit_movement - rolled.debit_movement END, 2 ) AS ending_balance, direct.opening_balance AS detail_opening_balance, direct.debit_movement AS detail_debit_total, direct.credit_movement AS detail_credit_total FROM rolled_account_values rolled JOIN account_nodes account ON account.account_code = rolled.account_code LEFT JOIN account_hierarchy hierarchy ON hierarchy.account_code = account.account_code LEFT JOIN direct_account_values direct ON direct.account_code = account.account_code ), daily_detail_lines AS ( SELECT journal.account_code, COALESCE( NULLIF(BTRIM(provenance.source_journal_number), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(journal.ref_num), ''), journal.transaction_id ) AS journal_number, journal.entry_date, COALESCE( NULLIF(BTRIM(line.source_destination_branch_id), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(journal.dimensions ->> 'office'), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(office.external_id), ''), office.id::VARCHAR ) AS branch_code, COALESCE(line.source_line_sequence::BIGINT, journal.id) AS detail_sequence, COALESCE( NULLIF(BTRIM(provenance.source_header_concept), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(provenance.source_header_description), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(line.source_line_concept), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(line.source_line_aux_concept), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(journal.description), ''), '-' ) AS entry_description, CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN ROUND(journal.amount, 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS detail_debit, CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 1 THEN ROUND(journal.amount, 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS detail_credit FROM qualified_journal journal JOIN m_office office ON office.id = journal.office_id LEFT JOIN credesal_arissto_gl_journal_line line ON line.target_journal_entry_id = journal.id LEFT JOIN credesal_arissto_gl_journal provenance ON provenance.id = line.journal_provenance_id WHERE journal.entry_date = CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) ), daily_details AS ( SELECT detail.account_code, detail.journal_number, detail.entry_date, detail.branch_code, MIN(detail.detail_sequence) AS detail_sequence, MIN(detail.entry_description) AS entry_description, ROUND(SUM(detail.detail_debit), 2) AS detail_debit, ROUND(SUM(detail.detail_credit), 2) AS detail_credit FROM daily_detail_lines detail GROUP BY detail.account_code, detail.journal_number, detail.entry_date, detail.branch_code ), report_rows AS ( SELECT account.account_code AS sort_account_code, 0 AS row_order, 0::BIGINT AS detail_sequence, 'ACCOUNT'::VARCHAR AS row_type, account.account_code, account.parent_code, account.account_level, account.account_description, account.balance_nature, account.opening_balance, account.debit_movement, account.credit_movement, account.ending_balance, account.detail_opening_balance, account.detail_debit_total, account.detail_credit_total, NULL::VARCHAR AS journal_number, NULL::DATE AS journal_date, NULL::VARCHAR AS branch_code, NULL::TEXT AS entry_description, NULL::NUMERIC AS detail_debit, NULL::NUMERIC AS detail_credit FROM visible_accounts account
UNION ALL
SELECT account.account_code, 1, detail.detail_sequence, 'DETAIL', account.account_code, account.parent_code, account.account_level, account.account_description, account.balance_nature, account.opening_balance, account.debit_movement, account.credit_movement, account.ending_balance, account.detail_opening_balance, account.detail_debit_total, account.detail_credit_total, detail.journal_number, detail.entry_date, detail.branch_code, detail.entry_description, detail.detail_debit, detail.detail_credit FROM visible_accounts account JOIN daily_details detail ON detail.account_code = account.account_code ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY sort_account_code COLLATE "C", row_order, journal_number COLLATE "C" NULLS FIRST, detail_sequence ) AS display_order, row_type, CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) AS as_of_date, account_code, parent_code, account_level, account_description, balance_nature, opening_balance, debit_movement, credit_movement, ending_balance, detail_opening_balance, detail_debit_total, detail_credit_total, journal_number, journal_date, branch_code, detail_sequence, entry_description, detail_debit, detail_credit FROM report_rows ORDER BY display_order $report$ WHERE report_name = 'Balance de Saldos Detallado';
